subject: menu shell
defect: The full-screen charcoal menu with thin teal borders has little visual hierarchy or scenic connection to the illustrated world
notes: Seen on the Meadows production UI; check whether the same shell is shared across the other biomes before widening exposure.

subject: map
defect: The map canvas shows headings and markers without visible terrain or road context for the displayed destinations
notes: The 0% surveyed state may hide geography; capture a surveyed state before concluding that all map states share this defect.

subject: Team Tether stronghold
defect: The stronghold reads as a small dark ruin behind dominant pylons on approach and as a broad sparsely dressed stone room up close
notes: The generic capture stands are not verified route approaches; reshoot the authored approach before work is assigned.

subject: exploration HUD
defect: The many dark boxed HUD panels and outlined text occupy a large share of the exploration view
notes: This frame is inside a small room at an unfavorable angle; confirm against an exterior exploration frame.

subject: ground cover
defect: Thin grass and the same tall white flowers repeat over broad green slopes with few clustered color or rock breaks
notes: Repeated across several Meadows regions; compare route-walk samples before expanding sightings.

subject: mill and settlements
defect: The mill water is a broad flat blue surface with abrupt sparse banks and nearby settlements have little concentrated visible activity
notes: This merges the recurring lack of lively scene composition; split if later captures show independent causes or owners.

subject: secondary menu panels
defect: The Quests Build and Players panels leave most of their area empty around a few plain text lines or a single button
notes: The Skills capture repeats the Quests panel; it may be capture navigation or product behavior and needs a separate navigation check.

subject: shore landforms
defect: Repeated grassy domes with steep smooth gray rock skirts lack layered shore ecology and clear grass-to-sand transitions
notes: Confirmed across four seeded route/off-route frames; gray rock skirts and abrupt green tops are visible at near and far range.

subject: water and island depth
defect: Broad offshore water reads as uniform light cyan with little depth variation across several island routes
notes: Brine Steps shore has strong foam and wave detail; this row concerns open-water distance views only.

subject: Veilfall silhouette
defect: The distant Veilfall mountain reads as a near-geometric dark cone with narrow broken waterfall streaks
notes: The near cascade has a broad white curtain and mist in the route frame; limit this defect to far silhouette and landmark legibility.

subject: named destination read
defect: Several named route destinations read as unmarked grassy slopes or small generic structures instead of distinct halls arches or terraces
notes: Seeded route proxy corroborates generic location stands; reshoot true authored route before assigning site work. The Gull Rest tower itself remains a visible local marker.

subject: Burrow Warrens hillside
defect: The hillside beside the Burrow entrance exposes a broad rectangular brown terrain face with straight edges and a dark cut
notes: Repeated in two seeded off-route stands; check authored entrance approach for extent.

subject: Tether Relay yard
defect: Tall flowers and grass grow densely through the flat trafficked relay yard around guards crates and ramp
notes: Two ordinary camera views at the route proxy.

subject: distant mountains
defect: The mountain backdrop has hard isolated facets and dark slash shapes instead of continuous landform silhouettes
notes: Distant backdrop defect is separate from near-ground repetition; check if this backdrop is shared with another biome.

subject: creature collapse and rest
defect: Several fainted bodies remain upright or float above the grass and some resting poses do not settle onto the ground
notes: The direct pose fixture needs confirmation in a real faint/rest transition; explicit hovering is visible in Trailpup and Veridian.

subject: creature hurt and movement poses
defect: Hurt and moving frames often retain the idle silhouette so the state is difficult to read without a filename
notes: Still frames cannot establish locomotion timing; check production transition captures before scheduling animation work.

subject: normal creature scale
defect: Several normal creatures read visibly shorter than the trainer in the shared near-framed scale view
notes: Apparent visual height varies with perspective and posture; compare with declared size and a level camera before adjusting assets.

subject: shiny palette distinction
defect: Some shiny variants have no reliably readable colour-block difference from their normal form at the device view
notes: Other species have strong shiny distinctions; assess these pairs at the same lighting and camera.

subject: alpha rarity read
defect: Several alpha variants read mainly as a modest size increase without a distinct staged presence beside the trainer
notes: Mosshell alpha has a stronger looming silhouette; a staged world encounter may read differently from this controlled pair.

subject: creature ground contact
defect: Dense foreground grass obscures several creatures feet and lower outlines in the normal camera view
notes: Do not infer floating from grass occlusion alone; explicit hover is cataloged in P2-015.

subject: open terrain
defect: Broad level grass fields and sparse ordinary trees dominate Cloudreach views where layered elevated land and ledge detail should lead the route
notes: Code-blind location verdict. Some generic teleport stands may face away from authored elevated route; compare a route-grounded frame matrix before final assignment.

subject: summit aviary
defect: The summit landmark reads as a small skeletal dome on grass beside a separate court instead of a layered stone sanctuary and its night silhouette stays dark
notes: A recognizable distance marker exists but the hero structure is visually thin in approach and close views.

subject: exposed landform edges
defect: Floating island undersides form blunt dark slabs and several cliffs and grassy shelves have conspicuous straight extruded edges
notes: Grouped as one recurring exposed-edge geometry defect; inspect whether cliff and island meshes share an authoring path.

subject: architectural landmark read
defect: The Windscar Beacon broken skyroad arch and Old Wind Observatory present plain or blank structures with weak landmark-specific detail
notes: Usable approach frames support this; close observatory captures are pressed against the wall and should be reshot.

subject: grass and stone finish
defect: Tall grass intrudes through shrine paving while repeated grass and simple stone surfaces reduce close-range material distinction across sites
notes: The shrine close frame is partly wall-obstructed but grass intersection is visible; confirm on a corrected stand.

subject: Veilfall approach shallows
defect: A ruler-straight chain of nearly identical tan discs with white rims makes the Veilfall approach read as mechanical stepping stones rather than natural current shallows
notes: Recurring from three route views; the thin white water marks reinforce the straight disc chain.
